Our server was very attentive and made several suggestions for our meal.  The appetizer was the shrimp and crab dip which was tasty.  Our mains were good but honestly nothing

reviews.author: LaRae Frolik
reviews.text:
Edited: since my post I have been in contact with management. They apologized for the service and lack of eggs. They have also offered  to make it up to us at another time. I appreciate management making  the time to make it right.
Original: We made a reservation for brunch. A well advertised and re

name: Bella's Pizza
address: 2601 S McKenzie St, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Kirstin Powley
reviews.text: Biggest mistake! Really should of turned away when they were reheating the food! Don't understand how they have a 99 for an inspection! 2 small bites and I was done! 2 small bites is all it took to make me sick hours later! Waste of money! Don't go here! Save yourself the tummy ache and waste of money!

reviews.author: Stephen Duke (Eaglescoutduke)
reviews.text: Payed $20 for a grocery store hotdog with canned Chilli and the Stromboli. I was supposed to get chips with my Chilli dog and didn't. We also ordered a large "fresh" lemonade that was literally  Kool Aid Lemon. 2 people tried to refill drinks while they were ringing my food up and they freaked out asking them to run a credit card for 55c and charging a 25c card fee. Overall this place is one big scam. Nothing is what they advertise. They also sell beer and mixed drinks for some reason?

reviews.author: Gayle McDow
reviews.text:
Worst calzone I've ever paid money for. Literally had 3 pepperoni, 6-8 pieces of diced ham and a ridiculous amount of ricotta cheese.   Bread was chewy, hard to cut.

Stromboli was much better. Guess I picked the wrong thing...

reviews.author: Matthew Gahafer
reviews.text: This place is an absolute joke.   Pizza was terrible.   8 dollars a slice would be okay if it were actually good.   They don't even use real cheese but cheese "product".   Avoid this place like the plague.

reviews.author: Judy Aquino
reviews.text: This is a great place to eat! The people are friendly and the food is good, especially the pepperoni pizza it's so good, I normally don't eat pizza, but when my friend asked me to try it, which I did, and it was so good and not regretting it. I'll definitely recommend it. I assure you you'll like it.

name: Bier Shack Taproom Restaurant
address: 8191 AL-59, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Frank Lapcheske
reviews.text: Amazing place and great food,  it is awesome. I come here weekly and love the people, the management and staff. Absolutely the best Ruebin ever and Patricia was an amazing bartender. You are missing out if you don’t try this place. The schnitzel is amazing

reviews.author: Leigh E
reviews.text: We are snowbirding in Foley and decided to give this place a shot.  The chicken schnitzel is delicious as well as the pretzel and we are not big eaters, sharing an entree.  The chef splits our meals up on different plates (without asking) .  It's our go to place to go to now.  Great happy our specia

reviews.author: Mary Henry
reviews.text: Wow what a great local find!  I can't say enough good things about this spot. From the moment we walked in, we were treated like regulars —even though it was our first visit. Patrise was incredibly knowledgeable about the beers on tap and the food they had available and was happy to offer recommenda

reviews.author: Rick Chesser
reviews.text: The BEST german based eatery i’ve had!!! Braut’s & kraut were delicious, pretzel appetizer was so tender and the schnitzel was truly Devine!! Comfortable environment, the staff was nothing less than fantastic. A perfect lunch time dining experience

reviews.author: Joe H
reviews.text:
The Bier Shack is under new ownership, and they are absolutely knocking it out of the park! It’s so much more than just axe throwing now—it’s a full-on destination. They’ve managed to create a fun, friendly environment that feels welcoming the moment you walk in.
​The addition of German food and a g

name: Big Beach Brewing
address: 300 E 24th Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Snow Gypsies Travelers
reviews.text: We had Fun here!! we sat by the Fireplace listen to some Great music 🎵 Buy Billy Bones!! awesome Beer 🍻 and Wine 🍷 great time great place great location.

reviews.author: William Atkins
reviews.text: Great brewery with wonderful bartenders! The beers were excellent! I didn't try the sours so I can't speak to those but all the others were good or great! Plus boiled peanuts! I'd never had them before so this was a new and very welcome experience. I had to post a picture of the taps because they are individually crafted glass. I would have posted a photo of the wonderful bartenders but I didn't ask their permission to post their images.

reviews.author: Carla Morrin
reviews.text: The beers were great, however the blond woman serving us at the bar was super rude both times we went to the counter She wouldn't answer questions and acted like we were inconveniencing her. The food was good too. Very disappointing! There is no reason to treat us like that when we got beers, food, and merchandise.

reviews.author: Michael Cornelison
reviews.text: As a person that has visited many breweries, Big Beach Brewing hit all marks. Fun atmosphere, quick and friendly staff and great beer. They have a wide selection of easy drinking beers to fun and creative beers with full flavor. I left with a six pack to take home. I would highly recommend if you are in the Gulf Shores area to stop in and check out some of their artisanal craft beers.

reviews.author: Paul Fenrich
reviews.text: This is a must stop if you are into craft beers. We tried four different beers, and they were all delicious.  The bartender was very nice, and he had a lot of knowledge of their products. The atmosphere was great. We sat outside on the upper deck and then moved downstairs. The weather was perfect, and the boys found a new friend to play cars with. Very kid friendly, several families were hanging out.

name: Big Fish Restaurant
address: 25814 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Teresa Peters
reviews.text: Big Fish is our favorite restaurant in the Orange Beach area. They have so different kinds of fish & options on how to prepare it. The presentation is always beautiful! We ate here only once last year while visiting and when going this year, Chris remembered us and said: Hey, you are my Iowa friends. That tells you how good the service is. We are eating there tonight for our 3rd time this visit! Picture is the bronzed grouper. I did substitute the spinach for green beans. Ask for the Cilantro li

reviews.author: Implant-R-Us
reviews.text: The Sashimi Sampler & Rainbow roll was phenomenal. The fish was so tender you savored every bite. We also had the firecracker shrimp fired rice was tasty.  I couldn't have asked for a better way to end my night.

reviews.author: Jason Zeleny
reviews.text:
Big Fish is probably our favorite restaurant to go to when we're down at Orange Beach, AL. No matter what you order on the menu, it's always amazing. Even my daughter's grilled cheese was awesome (and I don't usually like grilled cheese). I do recommend a reservation as this spot is popular.

We ordered a couple of the fresh catches of the day finished with the Big Fish style topping, fire cracker shrimp (with added spice), ribeye steak, and grilled cheese. Thanks for the amazing and memorable d

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text: The food is absolutely divine! I highly recommend the grouper with the asian twist. The cucumbers were also outstanding, and the sushi was a hit. We love coming here and can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Nikki Wilson
reviews.text:
6 top there for a birthday party and we had: appetizers of beef tataki, seaweed salad, cucumber salad, dumplings, and crab claws. The only seasoning on anything of those dishes was the sesame oil on the beef. Then we each got entrees and drinks. I can’t speak to what everyone thought about their entrees, but…
I worked for a sushi restaurant in college, so I can tell just by looking at a spicy tuna roll whether or not it will be good. And when they sat my plate down I was bummed.
Overall, not a b

name: Billy's Seafood
address: 16780 River Rd, Bon Secour, AL 36511, USA

reviews.author: Katie Nuest
reviews.text: If you want fresh seafood at a great price, this is the place to be!  The owners and workers are wonderful as well!!

reviews.author: Kevin Cheadle
reviews.text: Excellent choices of sea food, and other items.  The hot fresh crawdads were some of the best I've ever had, when you go to Billy's don't forget to get some hot fresh crawdads.

reviews.author: Randall Sujat
reviews.text: I asked for large shrimp from front showcase. They pulled the shrimp from a large trash barrel. The shrimp were small to medium. Much smaller than the ones displayed. Very disappointed ☹️. Photo doesn't depict the whole pound.

reviews.author: G Man
reviews.text: The pictures will explain pretty much everything. These were supposed to be 16 to 20 ct shrimp.  It was also supposed to have been a pound. Check out the wild varying size of the shrimp and also the quantity. I included the spoon for scale. That's not a regular size plate. That's a small dessert pla

reviews.author: Andy Frazier
reviews.text: I have been coming to Billy’s to get fresh grouper, shrimp, oysters, flounder, and other things that swim for quite awhile now and let me tell you, it doesn’t get any better if you want fresh off the boat seafood. If it swims, they have it and it’s fresh! Billy’s knows how to treat their customers.

name: Blalock Seafood & Specialty Gulf Shores
address: 1911 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Wendy Pounds
reviews.text: The spicy “Low Country Boil” from Blalock Seafood Market was a total winner! Loaded with fresh shrimp, corn, potatoes, and Conecuh sausage — all steamed to perfection and packed with bold flavor. Messy, delicious, and totally worth it. YUM!

reviews.author: Jennifer Gleason
reviews.text: The ladies were extremely helpful! The shrimp boil is amazing, great price, and more than enough food. We ordered 6 orders (family of 6) $10 an order. And we were able to eat it for 2 meals and still had plenty left over.

reviews.author: Tony Mason
reviews.text: Inexpensive and high quality low country boil. We picked it up on the way home from Saturday night mass.  We will do this again.   Staff was friendly and helpful, food was great.  Shrimp were perfect!  Too many places over cook their shrimp, these were excellent!

reviews.author: Blair Bauer
reviews.text: I love coming back home to visit family and my grandfather requested that we pick up some steamed shrimp from Blalock’s for dinner. It was actually the first time I had been in there after unknowingly passing it for years. The staff was very friendly and helpful. We got 1.3lbs of medium-sized shrimp

reviews.author: Sariah Brooks
reviews.text: The shrimp and snow crab legs were cooked to perfection.  The owner, Alex, was extremely helpful and so nice.  And the cashier was friendly and helpful.  There were so many good seafood choices I wish we’d discovered it sooner on our trip; we would’ve bought food there every day.  And it smelled del

name: Blalock Seafood Orange Beach
address: 24822 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Margarita Stamatelaky
reviews.text: I am from California and wanted to try a local seafood  store.I came here and found the place on google and I am happy I did. The staff was friendly and loved the seafood display. I got delicious shrimp from the golf of Mexico and red snapper.

reviews.author: Annie Girl
reviews.text: Beautiful seafood market in Orange beach. Clean and loaded with fresh seafood and accoutrements! Prices were high, but that’s expected in February. Nonetheless, the fresh shrimp we bought & boiled were great! Friendly fast service!

reviews.author: nick ciranni
reviews.text: Excellent choices of fresh seafood. They can cook the fresh shrimp in a matter of minutes, and send you off with ice to keep them cold. If you want them cleaned, deveined and cooked you need to call an hour ahead. We took the cooked shell on shrimp with ice to the beach, topped it off with their exc

reviews.author: Jeff Hockin
reviews.text: We have been in OB for a month and their fish has been excellent! Great selection and friendly service. Highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.author: Lee Baker
reviews.text: The young man who waited on us was so nice.  He was a sophomore in HS and had a hurt arm.  He showed respect by saying Yes sir & no siret.  Same age as our grandson.

name: Bleus Burger Restaurant and Bar
address: 3800 Gulf Shores Pkwy #240, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Smith
reviews.text: Late lunch, went for a burger, ordered the shrimp n grits, glad I did. Wow! Plump, blackened shrimp, 6 pieces, grit cakes were delicious, piping hot, the sausage & cream sauce were wonderful. Like I said, I keep showing up for a burger but they do a lot of things really well—guess I’m coming back. Good, friendly service, had an ice cold beer and thought about my next visit. I do love R&B so I could’ve stuck around. That's a nice touch. 🎶

reviews.author: James Barnes
reviews.text:
Cool atmosphere.
We were wanting a good burger after several seafood meals and this place didnt disappoint.

The burgers were delish. Our wing app was good, we got 2 flavors, and I also got the tater tots app along with my meal. Never had tots that good!

Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: alyxandra OB
reviews.text:
The best fried pickles we have ever had! Absolutely beautiful and equally delicious burgers- and i’m not typically a burger fan!
We came on a Sunday at around 11 and the restaurant was mostly empty. Food came out quickly and was super fresh, all staff were super helpful and friendly especially our waiter!
We will absolutely be back :)

reviews.author: Jennifer Gleason
reviews.text: After having all the seafood places we could handle, our Midwest bellies were craving a good burger mixed with some BBQ. The burnt end fries were amazing, the wings, the burgers were amazing! Wish we would have found this place sooner than our last 2 days here. Our waiter Austin, was absolutely the best server we have had down here this trip!

reviews.author: Sonya Wellman
reviews.text: If you've never been, you have to try this place. The burgers are amazing and the fries are seasoned and they taste so good. And on the chicken wings you have to try the sesame soy 👍🏻👍🏻 I will add a photo of the burgers on the menu, but I was told that some of the burgers are seasonal

name: Brick & Spoon - Orange Beach
address: 24705 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: H. Hays
reviews.text: This place was pretty busy for 10:30 on a Wednesday and we found out why! We were seated immediately upon entering.  Drinks brought out within minutes and order taken. Food was expedited with speed and precision. My wife ordered the patty melt, which was so hot she burnt her lip. My tacos were loaded with blackened shrimp and a perfect amount of seasoning. The Fries were hot and more addictive than that fast food place with a big M in its name. Our waitress Carolyn B was fast and efficient all w

reviews.author: Wanietta Stuckey
reviews.text: We arrived at Brick & Spoon for breakfast at 9:45 and we're seated immediately. The menu is big with a good variety. They serve cirn or cheese grits with almost all of their breakfast choices. My husband ordered the Traditional Eggs Benedict and breakfast potatoes. He had hoped for it to be on a homemade biscuit but it was on an English muffin. He said it was really good. I ordered the Western Scrambler with fruit. I got the berry fruit rather than the melon fruit. Delish! I couldn't eat all of

reviews.author: Eunice Watters
reviews.text:
Absolutely Amazing Experience!

If you’re in Gulf Shores and looking for a place that delivers on every level, Brick & Spoon is it!

From the moment we walked in, the customer service was warm, welcoming, and genuinely friendly. The staff made us feel appreciated and taken care of the entire time. You can tell they truly enjoy what they do.

Now let’s talk about the food… WOW. Everything was perfectly cooked and incredibly well-seasoned. Every bite was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented

reviews.author: Marialexandraa Ochoa
reviews.text: The food was fantastic. The restaurant was great but what really impressed us was the server. We were on our way out of alabama and got here at opening hour.  About 4 other groups walked in and she absolutely killed it. Nikki needs a raise. We got outstanding service and the food and drinks were a bonus! Make this stop if you're ever in town!

reviews.author: Bobbi Masino
reviews.text: The Brick & Spoon was delicious.  My husband and I went in for a late breakfast and really enjoyed our selections. I had the Fried Steak Breakfast which came on top of a delicious biscuit with gravy. Over easy eggs and a delicious spicy honey drizzle. My husband got the Cajun Shrimp Benny which came with a side of potatoes. He really enjoyed the entree the potatoes were just potatoes. The star of the show was the breakfast fries. That came covered in gravy, diced tomatoes, a Sunnyside egg on top

name: Brookman's Smokehouse
address: 1544C Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Tamara Johnson
reviews.text:
If you are in Gulf Shores or Orange Beach,  run here for an excellent meal option.
Hated waited until leaving to stop by.  Got the smoked pork chops.  One pork chop will feed two adults.   The flavor is on point and tender.  My car is still smelling like a smokehouse.   The prices very fair.  My GPS

reviews.author: Tony Weaver
reviews.text: Honestly some of the best smoked pork chops I've ever eaten. Lots of meats/fish to choose from. Sausage is excellent too. Definitely worth stopping in if in Gulf Shores. Just check hours first.

reviews.author: Kevin Holtzhouser
reviews.text: Smoked sausage, smoked pimento cheese, and smoked jalapeno were fantastic.  Glad we stumbled across this place.  So good that we’ll be going back before we leave town in a few days.

reviews.author: Andrew Lancaster
reviews.text: One of the best smoked places I ever visited. Got the smoked yellowfin tuna, smoked pork chop which is ridiculously thick, along with smoked sausage, smoked tuna dip, all had tremendous flavor, and the best part, unbelievable great prices for what you can get, feed the whole family no problem. The g

reviews.author: Michele Holtzhouser
reviews.text: This was maybe the best smoked meat I’ve ever had. Great prices too! The owner was very helpful in answering my gluten questions.

name: Bywater Beachside
address: 20800 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Latham
reviews.text: If you've been out all day or drunk as hell and are really really hungry it's edible. Nachos got that weird cheap frozen "grilled" chicken, canned jalapenos, and fake cheese. Ballpark style. Pizza about as good as chuck e cheese pizza or something similar. Street corn was good tho, tore that up

reviews.author: Morgan Biggins
reviews.text: Ron was absolutely amazing! He is the reason why we will be headed back there tomorrow. He recommended the fish and it was amazing.

reviews.author: Jessica Partain
reviews.text: First and only time. Pizza was okay, burger was a premade frozen patty (not so much as salt on it) and the bywater nacho’s were mediocre at best (from the canned cheese, three different kinds of unseasoned meat and not so great chips). 4.6 out of 5 star reviews, how? Maybe we just ordered three wron

reviews.author: Justin Cotten
reviews.text: Stopped in for drinks and the scenery. Nice place, the view was nice overlooking the ocean.  It's a good walk be prepared when going here. You have to pay to walk the pier. Neat place to stop in and have a drink. If it's cool out make sure to have a long sleeve shirt, especially if the wind's blowin

reviews.author: Shannon (NOLA Gent)
reviews.text: This is the restaurant located at the Gulf State Park Fishing Pier. The seating is all open air with a roof overhead along with a nice view of the beach and Gulf. The best thing about this place would be the view. The food left a lot to be desired and they served me a VERY mediocre burger then to ad

name: C'est Le Vin
address: 104 C South, N Owa Blvd, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Brew Dude
reviews.text: This was our 2nd experience there. Every bit as good as the first. The charcuterie board is one of the best we've had anywhere! ALSO one of the few (if-not-only)area  establishments that has the class to offer Edmund's Oast beers - NICE!

reviews.author: Kevin Rosborough
reviews.text: We happened to find this little gem hiding at OWA; be sure and talk to Holly the owner and sommelier; she knows her wine; the selection is superb; have a charcuterie plate and enjoy a wonderful experience tasting some great international wines

reviews.author: tommy 454
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Who knew a late-night food quest could lead to such a hidden gem? We stumbled into C'est Le Vin in Foley, Alabama, because, well, it was late and options were scarce. But boy, are those 5-star reviews right!

We came strictly for the food, and let me tell you, it did not disappoint. The dishe

reviews.author: Claudia Lewis
reviews.text: This was absolutely the cutest wine bar ever! You can make your own Charcuterie board and enjoy great drinks. Went for a date night and it was just perfect. The prices were very reasonable and they had some really great choices for the boards. This was a neat experience and very worth trying! The se

reviews.author: Elise Hatten
reviews.text: Eddie and Austin were awesome! The charcuterie boards were great (especially the goat cheese). My husband had the smoked Blade and Bow old fashioned, and I had the Forbidden Sour and Italian Margarita. Drinks were great!! We will be back.

name: Cactus Cantina Canal Road
address: 25908 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Sweet_Southern_Living
reviews.text: Food is always delicious! The staff is friendly, brings your chips & salsa quickly 😋 and makes sure you don't run out if anything during your meal. Best Mexican Restaurant on the island!

reviews.author: Joshua Slavens
reviews.text: Another Mexican restaurant that gives you small portions for full price. Charging $40 for two of these is ridiculous! Dining in gives you bigger portions, but hard to support a business that rips you off with takeout.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: Food was REALLY good!!! Atmosphere isn't super traditional and this place gives fusion vibes. Food was great! Lots of flavor and variety, fast service, excellent margaritas! Such a great little laid back casual Mexican meal.  We will be back! Highly recommend the rainbow margaritas and 3 amigo dip ♥️

reviews.author: Kevin Johnson
reviews.text: So, I've heard Mexican food is non-existent in Gulf Coast Alabama.  This place consistently rated the best. Well, it isn't great. The food was ok, but not Mexican in the least. The chips were good, light and served warm. The sauce they came with was ok. The service was excellent and the atmosphere was good. I'm from Arizona,  so my standards are high. Will I go back, yes. It's all we have out here unless I cook my own.

reviews.author: Larry Crain
reviews.text: My go to restaurant whenever I'm in Orange Beach Alabama. Great food , amazing atmosphere, awesome wait staff & management, plus good prices! Chicken and steak quesadilla was huge, served fast & hot. If you haven't been to this restaurant on Canal Road you need to put it on your list to try.

name: Cactus Cantina Perdido Beach Blvd
address: 25311 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Vikas Chilkuri
reviews.text:
Nice place, we went at 4 something relatively slow.. but in an hour it filled up and it was busy by 5!!
The food was great, lots of familiar dishes, but they also have a few unique ones, not found in your usual local hometown mexican joint.
Leroy our server was great, not too overbearing and just the right amount of checking in! Overall I'll recommend to anyone and will probably go back when we are in the area again.

reviews.author: Dil Singh
reviews.text: Food was okay, not many vegan options. Drinks where amazing! Didn't like they changed extra cause we wanted spicy salsa. The chips and salsa were kind of bland. I order the shrimp tacos and definitely needed some of the hot sauce. Wife got vegan tacos and didn't like it as much

reviews.author: Gloria Holmes-Palmer
reviews.text: This restaurant is wonderful.   Our waitress Ashton was so helpful in deciding which meal best fit our taste.  She was right.  I had the grilled shrimp tacos and my husband had the pineapple fajitas. The next time we go back to Ocean Beach, we will go back to this restaurant.   Ashton you are the best!

reviews.author: R Farmland
reviews.text: Excellent food. But the chips were a little weird. They were very thin and tasteless. And the salsa was ketchupy. But the chicken was excellent and reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Sheley White
reviews.text: The food is amazing 🤩 and the price was cheap. The bathroom could have felt a little cleaner but the place is busy. The decorations were great and a lot of little kids were there with the families and they seemed to really like it so I would say it's a good family atmosphere. The bar was nice and had plenty of drinks to choose from. The salsa is spicy I loved it. I even paid 53¢ for extra spicy sauce. I had taken it out, so I carried it back to the room. I had the deluxe nachos with shredded chi

name: Change of Pace at Turquoise Place (Turquoise Place Guests Only)
address: 26350 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Beka Baer
reviews.text: Their food and drinks are amazing. We’ve been here 6 days now, and have tried this place multiple times (breakfast lunch and dinner) and each and every time it is GOOD. Food is full of flavor, menu is diverse with decent options for everyone (even the chicken finger kids) and the employees have been kind and helpful, each time. We don’t drink alcohol, and they gave us plenty of different choices for mocktails too! I feel Like they would do really well if they opened the restaurant to DoorDash, o

reviews.author: Bobby Montgomery
reviews.text: Better food than I expected from a pool side venue. I liked my turkey club.

reviews.author: Heather Hall
reviews.text: This place has the BEST food. We’ve tried several items and they have all been great. My favorite is the cheese nachos. The employees are all very friendly and after even just one time of me ordering, they had my order memorized. Honestly one of my favorite parts of Turquoise Place.

reviews.author: Susie Paschall
reviews.text: Great food!!

reviews.author: Heath Hulsey
reviews.text: Good drinks and food, good service

name: Chicken Salad Chick
address: 160 Cotton Creek Dr Unit 290, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: owen Utsey
reviews.text:
Chicken Salad Chick in Gulf Shores is a casual, welcoming eatery that specializes in a wide variety of chicken salad flavors, offering something for everyone’s taste. The restaurant’s menu features classic, savory, and unique blends, along with fresh sides like fruit, pasta salad, and pickles. The portion sizes are generous, and the meals are served fresh, making it a satisfying option for lunch or a light dinner.

The atmosphere is bright and friendly, with a cozy, small-town charm that reflect

reviews.author: Christy Oyer
reviews.text: Great place! Chicken Salad was amazing. So many different styles to choose from.

reviews.author: jess w
reviews.text: Chicken Salad Chick offers a fantastic, refreshing alternative to the typical fast-food run. It’s a great spot when you're craving something lighter but still satisfying. I'm a huge fan of the Fancy Nancy, which is beautifully mixed with pecans, grapes, and apple—it's sweet and savory perfection! Pair that with a side of their incredibly fresh Broccoli Salad, and you have a winner. Don't overlook their seasonal soups, either; they are always rich and comforting. Highly recommended for a quick, q

reviews.author: Rob Huey
reviews.text: Let me say I’m not a huge chicken salad person but this was definitely a great impression on me. Spectacular views, especially at sunset sitting outside!

Food was good, service was beyond excellent. Plenty of seating from bar to booths to outside patio.
Definitely worth a stop here & enjoying a good meal.

Also have a nice sized gift shop with sweets & jewelry/shirts type items.

reviews.author: Thomas Hodges
reviews.text: STOP HERE NOW!!! This place is fabulous… everything from the food to the view. We had the shrimp and crab dip (only recommendation, I’d add lemon, so ask for a side of them), pecan crusted catfish, tuna melt and bread pudding. The pecan crusted catfish I was skeptical… but the crunch they get on it is wonderful (I only know one way to eat fried catfish and that’s with coleslaw, tartar sauce and hot sauce… it didn’t disappoint). It was just delicious, so do yourself a favor and give it a shot!

reviews.author: Irma Montarsi

reviews.author: Brendan James
reviews.text: Tried Cobalt for the first time during a December trip to Orange Beach and it exceeded expectations. Even with a 45-minute wait, there was plenty of seating and a fun souvenir area to check out. I had the bronzed Gulf grouper and my wife ordered the fried shrimp—both were fantastic, and the grouper was one of the best meals I’ve ever had. Highly recommend and can’t wait to return on our next trip!

Everything was delicious and the service was absolutely the best possible!!

DeSoto has been a favorite for many years and continues to exceed our expectations!!

Without question the best seafood (maybe best restaurant) in Gulf Shores. The Grouper (blackened) was phenomenal, the popcorn shrimp perfection, but the sides (I went with fried green tomato’s, slaw, and turnip greens) made the meal.

Service was great - atmosphere fun and friendly - clean and family oriented.

Couldn’t recommend the place enough - was in town for 3 days and ate meals here twice.

reviews.text: Stopped in there on our way down from Indiana. They was super helpful with our selections. We will definitely be back and possibly order some over the phone. Definitely buy from them if u want good solutions.

reviews.text: We stopped by a seafood market while visiting Gulf Shores and had such a great experience! The customer service was excellent, and I loved the option to build your own bag/boil with corn, potatoes, sausage, and shrimp in whatever size you choose. I went first and brought it back to my family, and th

MORGAN to Gulf Shores (where the grocery stores are) and purchased 4 pounds of fish. Dude weighted it up and kept it in refrigerator till our way by to the beach house.  Grilled f

name: GTs On The Bay
address: 26189 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Cathy Skinner
reviews.text: Best meal we have has this trip so far. The atmosphere is casual and the view of the bay is fantastic. Salena was our server and she did an outstanding job serving us and happily answered our questions about dishes on the  menu. Our meal was shrimp & grits, salad bar and I had fried shrimp platter with whipped loaded sweet potato &  coleslaw. Kid friendly. We will be back!

reviews.author: Jason Allen
reviews.text:
We always seek out a new to us place for dining on our trips to Gulf Shores, and saw lots of suggestions for GTs on The Bay!

Our visit started a bit awkward as we approached the hostess stand, none of the three ladies seemed interested in greeting us. So we politely let them know we had a party of 4 and one of them made the sacrifice of leading us to a table.

Our waitress was very friendly and suggested some appetizers from the happy hour menu despite it being almost an hour past happy hour.

reviews.author: Bruce Woodward
reviews.text:
From the moment we pulled into the parking lot which was maintained and organized, and walking thru the 10 foot high wood & glass entry doors, I felt this place was special. Warm beach woods lined the waiting area and a long hallway to get to the main dining room with its large open top "pool" that had large native fish circulating in it.

We walked through the nicely appointed interior dining and headed for the huge covered patio, which was open to the north highlighting the view of the slightl

reviews.author: Doug Taylor (DixieDoug)
reviews.text: The food and service are first rate.  GT's is part of a group of restaurants that feature great food and service!  This doesn't happen by accident, and their operation isn't hit and miss. I had collard greens, smashed Yukon potatoes and the Yellowfin tuna. My goodness gracious it was good!  My friend had the Seared Atlantic Salmon Salad.  We each ordered a craft draft beer because it was Happy Hour.  Both beers were good!  We traded "tastes" of our entrees, and my friend's salmon was excellent!

reviews.author: NobodyTL
reviews.text:
The best part of our experience was Hope - she was very kind and patient, and even helped me pick my entree. The portions are VERY generous, so you may want to skip the appetizers.

Firecracker Shrimp - very salty, but the sauce had a great flavor; just not very spicy.

Surf n Turf - I got it with the Blackened Shrimp. The star of the meal was honestly the grits at the bottom of the plate. The steak was seasoned well, but was pretty tough cooked at a Medium-Rare. The Shrimp was good as well, not

name: Gary's Brewery & Biergarten
address: 208 Newman Ave, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.text: Came here for the first time today for a wreath making class and it was so much fun fun! The Glühwein was delicious (tastes just like what I used to enjoy in Germany) and my wreath turned out fabulous. Seems like a very friendly place with regulars that have been going there for years. Oh and happy

reviews.author: Mary Steinacker-Grimm
reviews.text: Bingo night is fun, it is dog friendly, but there’s a lot of places to explore and sit as well. The staff is super friendly and there’s a board where you can buy a beer for someone who really needs it, like a hospice nurse!

reviews.author: Ryan Beverly
reviews.text: This place is pretty awesome, great setting and venue, plenty of outdoor seating on a beautiful day to enjoy the fresh air.  Overall the ambience is very free flowing, nice selection of on tap beers, ( Smoked Gary) is Highly recommended. Also a plethora of other options including wine slushies and s

reviews.author: Jeffrey Cowgill
reviews.text:
Just wow! I’ve been by here many times and finally decided to stop in and check it out.  Totally surprised and happy to see this super cool place out here just off Barrancas. It’s a neat combination of outdoor spaces complete with gardens, a bamboo maze and plenty of shady areas with tables.

UrbanC

reviews.author: Mike Hall
reviews.text:
Friendly staff, great beer, great music, and awesome ambience. The food truck was amazing as well! Very easy to get to from the beach, just a short drive.
The fire pit was great as it was a chilly night.

name: Ginny Lane Bar and Grill
address: 4851 Wharf Pkwy E suite D100-D106, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marilyn Washburn
reviews.text:
Decided to try a place we hadn't been to before and we're so glad we did! The food was absolutely delicious (pecan crusted chicken, baked oysters in truffle and garlic, calamari, grouper topped with lump crab, and fried crab claws)!!
I've actually had better claws but they were still good. 👍🏼
It was lovely dining outside on Portage Creek and inside offered live music with a cozy, elegant atmosphere.
Our service was fast and friendly...wonderful off-season experience! 🥰

reviews.author: Carol Lengerman
reviews.text:
GREAT HAPPY HOUR MENU from 11-6pm

Shrimp special today: $20 all you can eat and comes with Cole slaw, hush puppies, and fries. Oysters were $1/apiece.  They were small but had good flavor.

Justin was a great waiter and we tipped him accordingly, but the bar service was unbelievably slow considering the staff to patron ratio was at least 2:1.

Great view of the ICW and yachts on the wharf.

This was not our first time here, and we were surprised at how run down it seemed.  With so many dining o

GL has a "hook and cook" service so we called ahead and spoke to Clint. He was super helpful and told us to bring them in and they would clean and cook them for us. reviews.author: Zoe Gehman
reviews.text: Great live music on Friday night! Very extensive menu with great options. Had a frozen watermelon margarita, gumbo (absolutely amazing) and jalapeño focaccia

reviews.author: Brian M
reviews.text: Food was ok.  Had the Bayou Grouper.  Not bad, but not great for the price.  Nice happy hour though.  We might go back during happy hour, but pick other items.

name: Glenlakes Golf Club
address: 9530 Clubhouse Dr, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Allison Krieger
reviews.text:
Great Place!
Beautiful golf course!
Friendly & helpful staff!
The Pub Bar & Restaurant is amazing!
I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: sheldon berkowitz
reviews.text: Granted - the course was almost completely dormant as I played in Mid -February, but still, I played another local course last week and the fairways were mostly green. Layout is ok - nothing special.pace of play was very slow on the front nine (2.5 hrs), but picked up on the back 9 which made it more enjoyable and we finished in 4.5 hrs. Driving range was not in great shape. Made my reservation online which saved some money. Would be interested to see what it was like in prime season. Pretty bas

reviews.author: David Whiteman
reviews.text:
Escaped the Minnesota cold for a weekend of golf in Alabama and decided to give this place a try. We played the Dunes-Vista 18 and found some really fun, well-designed holes.

The two nines have distinct personalities: the Dunes side features great undulating fairways that keep you on your toes, while the Vista nine offers much larger fairways and a more traditional resort-style layout. Even though it's February and the fairways and rough are still dormant, the greens were rolling surprisingly w

reviews.author: DOUG BRINTON
reviews.text: Went with my son and son in-law. We had a great time. Wasn't too busy so we could take our time. Since walking in the front door, we were treated like PGA pros. Cheaper course but in great shape. A couple of the fairways were messed up in spots but they have had a decent amount of rain lately. We will come back next time we visit Gulf Shores area.

reviews.author: Aidan Parker
reviews.text: First time here, gotta say I had a blast. Course layout is very fun and challenging. Tee boxes, fairways, and greens were in perfect condition for the price paid. I will be back!!!

name: Groovy Goat
address: 106 S Owa Blvd A, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Karen Sepko
reviews.text: Came to Groovy Goat for an event!  Event room is through the Arcade to the left.  I never knew it was there!  Great space for 70 people 7 tables of 10 people.  Food was buffet style included sprimp/chicken/mixed vegetables/ fettuccine Alfredo/ mixed salad and… the best ever chocolate chip cookies!!

reviews.author: Colleen Daugherty
reviews.text: Lots of beers on tap and a large arcade for kiddos. Great for large parties both family and adult. Lots of TVs and “the game” you want to see is always on. As far as quality of the food….is hit or miss for both lunch and dinner service: scores average overall with positives being portion size and southern-inspired side options, like black eyed peas, while negatives include sloppy food presentation paired with what I will describe as inconsistent kitchen technique. Order the right thing and it’s

reviews.author: Wade Bombenger
reviews.text:
Damn. Thanks for the suggestion, Wade. The Redfish Sandwich struck a nerve. I grew up on Redfish in Florida. My mom would put potatoes in the oven and challenge me to catch dinner. Then I caught Red Snapper. We ate when the potatoes were done.
Thank you.

reviews.author: Nicole Brown
reviews.text: Food was very over priced for the quality and amount received. We ordered a cob salad (which didn’t even come out with the corn) and the chicken tender plate. The chicken tenders were $17. They were very small and chewy (over cooked) and the fries were bright yellow and appeared to be old and stale. I usually don’t write or leave a bad review but I don’t recommend this restaurant. Service was fantastic, but food did not reflect this.

reviews.author: Deborah R Harton
reviews.text: We attended a team party in a reserved room after the state cup soccer tournament this past weekend.  There were at least 70 guests and they had 1 waitress to take all orders/drinks.  An hour and a half after taking orders and bringing out everyone's food she brings out 2 children's hamburger plates (we ordered the adult burgers) and those burgers and 5 fries (literally) made an Aldi frozen hamburger patty look like filet mignon.  We still did not have our appetizer Nachos to share,  which we ha

address: 4593 Main St Suite C-101, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Stacy Burgos-Rodgers, Realtor
reviews.text: When it first opened a friend and I checked this place out.  Cute decor, great service and we enjoyed a couple of espresso martinis! Life gets busy and we did not visit again until last week.  We came to a wine tasting and had the best time!  Enjoyed the Feta Dip and Charcuterie Board along with 4 wines!!  The service was FANTASTIC!  They made us feel like we were the only ones there!!!  I think we will make this more of a regular thing.  Orange Beach is lucky to have such a unique and fun conce

reviews.author: Amanda Arat
reviews.text:
Gulf Babe is that girl. From the moment you walk in, the vibes are immaculate—cute, fun, and effortlessly coastal-chic. The atmosphere is perfect for a girls’ night, brunch, or just feeling a little extra while you eat amazing food.

But what truly made our experience unforgettable was our server, Cindy. She was an absolute gem—so sweet, attentive, and genuinely made us feel taken care of without being overbearing. Cindy knew the menu inside and out, gave great recommendations, and kept everythi

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.text: Came here for an oyster ornament painting class and had the best time. The peppermint espresso martinis were divine, and the homemade hummus was tasty. The carrots looked like they’d been in the fridge too long, but other than that the snacks are perfect for the occasion. Will definitely be on the lookout for more craft classes here. Thank you for a festive evening! 🎄🎨🦪❤️

reviews.author: Emma Newby
reviews.text: My first time coming to gulf babes was for their season 4 Bridgerton watch party. Cindy greeted me with the most welcoming energy and even directed me to another women who came by herself for me to sit with. I quickly scoped the scene and sat with that women. We had a lovely time and Cindy was doing the most amazing job making sure our drinks were full and we got out munchies. She even offered to take my picture for me! She was just such a light and immediately calmed my anxiety when arriving to

reviews.author: Teresa Miller
reviews.text: Wendy was an absolute gem!! She paired the wines which were absolutely delicious. The peach bruschetta was amazing!! Great time great experience! 5 stars all the way!

name: Gulf Shores Diner
address: 3639 Gulf Shores Pkwy #4, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Rosefaith Masterpiece
reviews.text:
The food was absolutely amazing. I went with the Philly Steak Omelet, and it did not disappoint. It was packed with flavor, perfectly cooked, and the portion size was filling.
Arwa made the experience standout. Her service was excellent. She was genuine, welcoming, and the kind of hospitality that makes you feel like a regular even on your first visit. Everyone is so kind and welcoming.
I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Mary Steinacker-Grimm
reviews.text: This place is like coming home to family. In the year and a half that I have been eating at the Gulf Shores Diner on Sunday mornings with my parents, I literally feel like we are coming to the best place to have a meal on Sundays. All the staff treat us like family. The food is always delicious. The restaurant is always clean. You can buy local art. The menu is diverse and always made fresh.

reviews.author: Rob Huey
reviews.text:
No frills diner with good food, service and lots of options.

My brother-in-law (lives in this area) recommended this to me and I tried it this morning for breakfast. Andrew waited on me and he did an excellent job of making sure I had everything I needed. The food came out quickly and everything tasted great. It was a very good experience.

They also feature art from local artists which is very cool. I would definitely recommend stopping by here for breakfast.

reviews.author: Cruzana Hall
reviews.text: If I could give this place a negative rating I would. It started off by waiting for almost 30 mins for someone to take our order. They did apologize. We finally ordered the food and let me say it was the worst food ever. Order a hamburger and to be honest I don’t think that was even a burger patty. It had no flavor had a nasty taste to it. also ordered the Philly cheese steak and that was over cooked way too salty. The chicken sandwich the tomato was thicker than the chicken itself. The fries ha

reviews.author: JG
reviews.text: Nice Relaxing Breakfast. Went here for breakfast on a Tuesday.  The service was immediate and pleasant.  I ordered the Philly Steak Omelette.  It was very flavorful and cooked perfect.  The hash browns were good too. If you want a local, relaxed place to have a great breakfast. This is the place.

Went back later in the week. Got the same thing! Def recommend! Best ban

address: 27267 Perdido Beach Blvd #115, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Craig Bishop
reviews.text: We sat outside next to some fishing boats docked at the pier. Very nice atmosphere. Service was fast and the server was able to answer questions and make suggestions. I ordered the grilled yellow fin tuna special with shrimp and my wife ordered the steamed royal reds bucket for one (1 1/2 lbs.). Both entrees were absolutely delicious and perfectly cooked. It is definitely on our list to return as a favorite!

reviews.author: Michael Sanders
reviews.text: Good Grub.  I had the grilled grouper po boy and she had the chicken bowl.  The grouper was outstanding.  Very flavorful and moist. The wife enjoyed the chicken bowl.  We split a piece of key Lime pie...a little too sweet,  but was still very good.  We walked from the Perdido Beach Resort....was right across the street.

reviews.author: Schwingschwa
reviews.text:
We were really looking for good crab legs while down in gulf shores. This place was everything we were looking for. Everything from the location, service and the food was perfect.

We both decided to go with the crab boil that came with 2 crab leg groups, corn, potatoes, and gumbo for $40 at the time of writing this.

Our server was Paige I believe and she did fantastic! She took care of everything we needed. Was attentive without being over checking and we never wanted for anything.

All the cr

reviews.author: Kay
reviews.text: Delicious, flavorful seafood with filling portion sizes!! We got here close to closing time but the staff were happy to serve us and the service was top notch!

reviews.author: Susan Heath
reviews.text: Love that the patio (four tables) was dog friendly.  Food was delicious, atmosphere beautiful with the boats from the marina and our server was awesome.   Gumbo, stuffed shrimp, royal reds and tuna a must!

name: Gulf to Go
address: 287 Royal Dr, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Thompson
reviews.text: Have had good success with this service most of the time. But last night our order was almost an hour late and had no condiments that we asked for with some of our food. I can understand that things sometimes get left out, but at least call and tell me that it’s going to be late. Eventually they did call but it was 30 minutes past the supposed delivery time. Come on guys, need to do better than that!

reviews.author: Lisa Price
reviews.text: Order was over 30 minutes late being delivered and only thing driver said was yeah we have been busy. The total was more than my ticket said. They add fees onto delivery onto tip for driver. My $10 meal ended up being $20. Food was ice cold and they didn't include sauce that was requested.  Won't order from here again.

reviews.author: Annette Fleisher
reviews.text: Food was warm and was delivered about 45 minutes sooner than their time line!  I wish the site had more pictures of the food dishes because I ordered way too much food from the Mexican restaurant.  Please tip your delivery people...they just make money from tips and delivery fees.  Since I hurt my ankle, I'm glad I was able to get something besides Chinese or pizza!

reviews.author: Sarah Jean
reviews.text:
I use this service all the time, foods hot and always on time.

Since they switched to delivery.com there have been multiple comunication errors between the service and the restaurants. reviews.author: Harleigh Hughes
reviews.text: The delivery guy showed up 30 mins earlier than what was estimated and he was very nice. Food was still hot and fresh. Definitely would recommend and will be using again.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Hook Madden
reviews.text: Last night a group of 11 went to dinner and had a great experience! Our server Mariah, took great care of us! We never ran out of drinks, crab legs or hand to ask for anything! She made our dinner incredible! Couldn’t ask for any better service! We will be back!

name: Hooters
address: 300 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: G B
reviews.text:
Quite, cozy and friendly. The food  was fresh hot and delicious. There was no line and no waiting and our waitress deserved every penny of her tip. Also kudos to the cook who had our food well sauced, seasoned and temperature hot. GHOST PEPPER for me and Lemon Pepper for the lady. BTW make sure if you are a Veteran let them know before you let them bring you the ticked they offer 15% and not the average 10%.

Thanks guys and continue the good work. BRAVO ZULU!!!!

reviews.author: Bean NeFF
reviews.text: This was our first time here and it was an amazing experience!! The food was great, definitely one of the best Hooters I’ve been to. Our waitress, Jerzie, was outstanding! She was very friendly and a great server. Definitely recommend this place if you’re stopping by in Gulf Shores, Alabama.

reviews.author: JGordonSUX
reviews.text:
The Best Little Hooters In Alabama.

I've visited Hooters establishments literally around the world since before 2006. I don't know how many stores over the years. I've been to The World's First, World's Biggest, but today, I visited The World's Tiniest.

To me, this is where the charm is. I visited during lunch and dinner. Both times I was greeted wonderfully by the servers. There are only 11 tables inside, and 6 outside.

reviews.author: Featherbear19
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place! We came here to grab lunch while vacationing in Perdido Key and we are so glad we did! Delaney, our server, was excellent! She was so friendly, attentive, and quite funny too. The food was delicious and we will definitely go back when we are in the area. The view is beautiful as well!!!

reviews.author: k beard
reviews.text:
Fun waterside bar/restaurant. NOTE: Bikers-parking is gravel/dirt. Also- do NOT bring your pets. They will ask you to leave.
Staff was friendly, food was delicious and atmosphere is fantastic!

reviews.author: Meagan Kosbab
reviews.text:
Wow this is a must! We got the sampler app first which did not disappoint. For dinner we ordered the cheeseburger that got 2 thumbs up along with the boss baby. We also split their giant BLT and holy wow it was huge. Their potato salad is good but just know it's more of a loaded flavor. Bonus that the pieces are extremely reasonable.
We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Fernando Damus
reviews.text: I actually really like this place. Every time we are at Perdido we try to go. It is a very unique place where service, atmosphere and food work very well. I always order any of the sandwiches but I also hear that the wings are great. Sometimes there’s a band playing music. They have a bar and tv’s so you get the whole package. I totally recommend it!

reviews.author: Serena Caldeyro
reviews.text: It was okay. Nice atmosphere nicer if sitting outside. All the food looked good. They don't serve seafood only tuna salad. We were working from out of town & my son found this place. I  had my heart set on steamed  old bay shrimp but they don't serve seafood. Definitely bar food. Prices for beer decent, food for what some in our party ordered didn't meet expectations vs price. Muffala, mushroom burger, sampler, onion rings, wings & kids tenders all average, no complaints.

name: Hurricane Grill & Wings-Orange Beach
address: 25755 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Amy White
reviews.text: Great place to eat! We had a hard time deciding on what to order. My husband got the smothered burgerito that he said was really good. I got the Mahi sandwich and it was good.  We are fans of a fountain Pepsi, so that was a plus for us as well.  Kristen was very sweet and took good care of us.

reviews.author: Rachael Gaylord Cargill
reviews.text: Husband and I were here for Christmas. Not many restaurants were open. The hotel gave us a list of options and we chose Hurricane Grill &Wings. We were seated quickly and our server Patti suggested the wings. They were so, so, good. I had one of the best margaritas in my life. And the Miami Vice drink was very tasty. We will be back. Great service!

reviews.author: The Wade Life
reviews.text:
So we went twice because it was so good!
Party of 14 mixture of adults and kids.
They were super accommodating.
They went the extra mile!
The food was incredible!
We got chips and queso as appetizer both times. The second time we got tortilla chips instead of kettle.
All the food was better than the high priced sit down restaurants.
The shrimp was the best we had in orange beach and Pensacola.
Steak tacos were amazing!
The fajita bowl was delicious!
The staff and the environment was incredible!

reviews.author: Mark Lewis
reviews.text: Always a wonderful experience at Hurricanes Grill and Wings! The food was absolutely delicious. It’s always so fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. As always, everything came out hot and fast. Our waitress, LeeLee, truly made the visit even better. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without asking.   Great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. We’ll definitely be back and asking for LeeLee again!

reviews.author: Veronica M
reviews.text: By far, our favorite place we ate for 2025 Spring Break. Great food, great service, and a very cool vibe. Will eat here when we go back. Street corn was so good!! Burgers were fantastic.

name: Ice House Taproom
address: 112 Windmill Ridge Rd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.text: Stopped by Mikee’s today because I heard a rumor about all you can eat crab legs… Well, it’s not a myth! Worth the wait?! ABSOLUTELY! And what they don’t tell ya and my server Desiree did; is that you can switch up and order on any other AYCE platter, cooked different ways, as well as sides. On the

reviews.author: Britt
reviews.text: THE BEST “hometown” seafood in Gulf Shores. They are always our first stop for dinner when we come to Gulf Shores. All the food is in very generous portions and of high quality flavor. Family friendly atmosphere. Get there early on weekends or you will have to wait.

reviews.author: Timmi Otte
reviews.text:
Old school, casual atmosphere, polite and helpful staff and delicious, home cooked reasonably priced seafood. We got fried clams, gumbo with a house salad and shrimp salad. Homemade croutons and blue cheese dressing were delish!
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rick Woodall
reviews.text: We ate main dining room before and enjoyed it but when it's crowded it's very noisy, went back and ate in the bar area at a high top table and ee enjoyed the atmosphere much more. Would recommend to go ahead and get the all you can eat crab legs, very flavorful and meaty.

reviews.author: Eunice Watters
reviews.text:
I visited Mikee's Seafood during the last week of Mardi Gras while in Gulf Shores and were excited to try such a well-known local spot.

Unfortunately, the service left a lot to be desired. Even the gentleman who seated us had a bit of an attitude, which set the tone for the visit. Our waitress seem

name: Mile Marker 158
address: 4673 Wharf Pkwy W b, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Cam Paulding
reviews.text:
Strawberry butter! I've never heard of it, or had it for the matter, until we ate at Mile Marker 158, and it is interestingly good.

We showed up on a late Sunday and it was Bingo night. The place was full and I was sure there was going to be a wait. And I was wrong. The hostess immediately greeted

reviews.author: EJ W
reviews.text: We enjoyed our visit and meal at Mile Marker 158. Set back, near the hotel and marina, it's a nice little place with decent food. The service was quick and they were friendly. It was a weekday though, so not too busy. We had blackened grouper (a little too much spice, but good), and flounder with po

reviews.author: Amy White
reviews.text: Mile Marker 158 is a hidden gem! The food is amazing. The bread that was brought out before our meal was wonderful. It was nice and warm and the strawberry butter, oh my! My husband and I enjoyed the fish of the day,  grouper, with gouda smashed potatoes,  green beans topped with lemon beurre blanc.

reviews.author: Brian M
reviews.text: Nice view of the water.  Hidden gem in our book.  We went during happy hour.  Dozen oysters for $12.  Drafts $4.  Shrimp scampi $12.   All the food was great.  It's not just the price, it is the food as well.  Very tasty.  At least the scampi.  Either you love oysters or you hate them.  I happen to

reviews.author: Rosa Golden
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently dined at Mile Marker 158 and had a mixed experience. The weather was great but a little windy, and the view of the marina was beautiful. The staff was friendly and attentive.

I ordered the fried grouper, which looked perfect with a golden brown crust, but it was a bit too

name: Moe's Original BBQ
address: 25603 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: A. B.
reviews.text:
We found this awesome BBQ by smell. Sounds weird, but we could smell it long before we knew what it was and the smell sold us instantly.

We made the 1/2 mile trek down Perdido Beach Blvd and found it, the holy grail hidden amongst unsuspecting chain restaurants. From the stickers on the door to the awesome signs out front - we knew we were in for something good.

The nachos: amazing

The pulled pork: the most tender, fall apart pulled pork we have ever had. Anywhere (from Kansas City and beyond

reviews.author: BETH Dawson
reviews.text:
My family and I loved Moe's! I love the laid-back atmosphere. There's seating available inside and outside. There's lots of cool art and pictures on the wall that I enjoyed looking at. The staff was friendly and helpful when ordering.
I had the loaded baked potato with smoked chicken, and it was delicious and very filling.
I tried the Ribs my husband ordered (I forgot to get a pic), but they were tender and flavorful.
The children enjoyed chicken tenders, grilled cheese, fried Catfish, mac & che

reviews.author: William McIntyre
reviews.text: Normally I shy away from a chain BBQ place. But, the past reviews were correct. The pork had a nice smokey flavor. The service was outstanding. The chocolate Orea pudding was a nice side. It looked like many locals were they, which is a good sign. The atmosphere was very creative.

reviews.author: DL
reviews.text: Great food and a fun atmosphere to dine in. Unfortunately, they often run out of certain menu choices almost every time we are there. We keep going back though.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text: Had a very good lunch here. The wife got the pulled pork sandwich which was very good and I got the sausage sandwich and fries. It was really tasty. They use Conecuh Sausage which if you haven’t had it you need to get some!! The outside has a nice atmosphere.

name: Moe's Original BBQ
address: 20733 Miflin Rd, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Zoe Gehman
reviews.text: Very cute inside. Live music on Saturday night was great! I had the side platter with fried green tomatoes, hash brown casserole and cabbage casserole. All very good but the cabbage casserole was so amazing I’ll need to figure out how to make at home!

reviews.author: Amanda Major
reviews.text: *Moe’s Original BBQ, “A Southern Soul Food Revival,” is located near OWA on Mifflin Road in Foley, Alabama, several red lights off of HWY 59. It’s a chain restaurant, which really means absolutely nothing, because their food consistently tastes uniquely fantastic. I’ve never had a bad meal here, and the staff is always top notch. 🌟Moe’s has been serving Alabama-Style BBQ since 1988. For people like me who don’t cook, that means they slow-smoke their meat in a pit using oak and fruit hardwoods. T

reviews.author: Shawn Shepherd
reviews.text:
If you're looking for some good bbq and sides, this is the right place. And while the food was really good....the staff were amazing! Super friendly and knowledgeable about the menu, made recommendations (which were spot on) and genuinely appeared to like what they were doing.

We arrived closer to closing time but we're never rushed and even got to hear some singing as the staff were doing a final cleaning for the night.

We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Julia Tassin
reviews.text: First time eating at Moe’s and it was such a great experience! It’s dog friendly and everyone was so kind and sweet. I got the chicken nachos and it was delicious! The nice man even came outside to say hello and offer some turkey to my dog, overall just a great environment!

reviews.author: Kat F
reviews.text: Excellent barbecue place. Order your food at the front and it's delivered to your table. Food was very tasty and alot of it. Friendly staff.

name: O'choppers
address: 25910 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: L Kelley
reviews.text: Came here for the first time after basically getting rained out at The Wharf Ampitheater. Food is great. Patty Melt and Chicken bites are a must. Have a couple of darker beer selections plus normal light beer options. Miro served us at the bar and when we moved to a table. Service was top notch. Energy and vibe is great. 🤟👍👍

reviews.author: Charles Ross
reviews.text: My wife and I visited O’Choppers twice and sat at the bar just for a couple of beers. It was extremely friendly, and the price for beer was extremely reasonable.  Definitely plan on frequenting them when we’re back in the area

reviews.author: Chelsea Ross
reviews.text:
I came in tonight, never been. My dad passed away this week and I just wanted to sit somewhere where no one knew me and have a drink. I was greeted by Lucas (sp?) and asked if he had a drink menu. He laughed and asked what I was in the mood for… he made me the perfect rum punch and had great
conversation. While he had no idea what I was going through, his smile and hospitality meant more than he knew. Beautiful bar atmosphere, great drinks and clean facility. Will be back again! Thank you.

reviews.author: Rocky C
reviews.text: By far the absolute best wings and onion rings around! The atmosphere is always fun, service is always excellent, and the price is just right. They definitely have a repeat customer with me.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: I just stopped by for a drink yesterday, but this place is always a treat!

name: OSO at Bear Point Harbor - Orange Beach
address: 5749 Bay La Launch Ave, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Daneen England
reviews.text: Definitely one of the better restaurants that we’ve been to. We had grilled snapper as well as blackened grouper and black and shrimp. Also the bang bang shrimp. The Asian slow coleslaw was fantastic. Hush puppies were spot on. The service was top-notch. The restaurant is super cute. Lots of little chickens running around outside. The kid really loved being able to put the bear and sit out outside with the bear in the skeleton. It’s on the water the boats. The food was excellent and I will defin

reviews.author: Karen Simmons
reviews.text: I recently took a girls trip to Orange Beach and we tried OSO at Bear Point. We sat outside and the view was amazing. We watched as boats came in and had a beautiful sunset. We shared fried pickles as an app, which were good. I had the bang bang shrimp bowl which was amazing. Everyone in my party raved about their entrees. We will definitely be back. The live music was great, as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: William Wright
reviews.text: Came down to Oso on Bear Point today. Cool-laid back local vibe. Island time for sure. With great service. Has Happy Hour Monday-Friday from 2-6pm. $1.50 Busch Lights and cocktails. Bartenders are very friendly and attentive. They also have live music every night after 6pm. Outside. Inside-outside seating, patio seating outside inside, upstairs seating. This place is huge! Probably the coolest menu I’ve seen on the island yet! Menu is decently priced with awesome specials. Chef Ashton came out a

reviews.author: John Jones
reviews.text:
This was an absolutely wonderful dining experience!
We had a server, Ricardo, who had one of the friendliest and kindest smiles in all of south Alabama. His service was top tier and should be the standard of measure.
The food was phenomenal. It came out hot and fresh and very quick to the table from the time of order.
We had the blackened chicken tots, and the shrimp and crawfish nachos, and the grouper nuggets. The food was the best we've had all week! The grouper was fresh and delicious. I hig

reviews.author: Connie Churchill
reviews.text: Loved this place. Great food, you can tell that the chef loves his/her job. The food really tastes good and looks good. We listened to a band afterward at the bar area, and it was a good time! Will always go back when I'm visiting Gulf Shores/Orange Beach!

Honestly I’ll probably keep trying because I love supporting local breweries, but a miss so far.

reviews.author: Kim Langham

reviews.author: Kristin Mullenix
reviews.text: The quality of food is great, fast service, our server Caroline was friendly and knowledgeable of the menu. I love the atmosphere. We can’t wait to try other items. Cute Merchandise !!!

I had raw oysters for an appetizer and the soft shell crab for my meal with baked potato and salad bar for sides. reviews.text:
We had the triple combination seafood dinner plate with shrimp scampi, blackened mahi mahi, and fried flounder. And the salad bar with a cup of gumbo.

The gumbo was packed with shrimp and sausage.

All of the seafood was par excellence!! The salad bar here is the simply the best in this area. The high turnover of customers ensures that they serve the finest and best food.

The service was very good. This is a long standing top notch restaurant and it continues to exceed our expectations every t

reviews.author: Jeremy Duke
reviews.text: Good salad bar, fried mozzarella was good, liked that the marinara for them was served cold. The shell shocked oyster sampler was outstanding. My wife had the chicken Alfredo and it was good as well, it had too much sauce for her liking, but flavor was very good. Also had a side of cheese grits and they were outstanding.

reviews.author: Craig Gaddy
reviews.text: Food was good. Service was great. Salad bar was my favorite part. Gumbo was good.  It was a little cold. Beautiful setting though with good chance to talk. Everyone was so friendly.

reviews.author: Teri-ann Blake
reviews.text:
Luncheon platter and Shrimp and Grits are Excellent. The sides Cole Slaw, Red Beans and Rice, the Greens are best ever. The Server was exceptional. We took home Bread pudding that was very Delicious.

The Scenery very beautiful and peaceful

reviews.author: Brian Elliott
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience here. Got there early, sat outside on the deck. Food was delicious, service was excellent, timely and kind, thank you Mama T. They oysters were perfect, the blackened grouper perfectly cooked and not overly seasoned, even the sides were excellent.  I am sure this place gets packed and crazy.

reviews.author: Lu Desteli
reviews.text: Celebrated a birthday here couple weeks ago. It was my first time there. Lovely view of the water and birds and bridge. The food was excellent. We got there early so definitely saw lots of people come in after us but we had a very good time at opening on a Sunday afternoon. There is an elevator to the eating area for those who need a little extra help.

reviews.author: Jerry Dunne Sr
reviews.text:
(2 year update). Still a great place. Found out they have a 25% Discount in February. All good and beverages. If you like bread pudding you will love theirs

Great service, wonderful food and atmosphere, did I say great service?  Try the seafood bisque.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Went with the family for an early dinner and it was great.   The portions were a good size and tasty.  The wife had the red snapper and the kiddo had shrimp Alfredo.  The service was good and the location was great.   I would definitely add it to the list of places to eat when we come back.

reviews.author: Kurt Farnsworth
reviews.text: Two nights ago, the four of us ALL had Fantastic meals. Our server, Ava, was Absolutely Wonderful. She is an Outstanding asset to this business!  She made the entire experience a pure pleasure!

The food is good as well but not exceptional. The staff are all very kind and accommodating. The tour itself is very short and basicall

reviews.author: Gina Carter
reviews.text:
What an awesome lunch! We sat on their new front patio and celebrated our 7 months of sobriety while enjoying a NA Bush and deluxe pizza! The potato skins were amazing.

Lastly, Dan was the BEST server ever. So attentive, the order was perfect and he never let our drinks go empty!

reviews.author: Jeff Greenwell
reviews.text: Got this while on vacation. Thought we would give a local spot a chance with all the decent reviews. Pizza was undercooked, almost no sauce or cheese. Very undersized for being a “14 inch” pizza. $55 for 3 pizzas and dominos would have been better. Also not a good experience with the person on the phone taking orders. Take your business elsewhere if you want decent pizza. Not sure of other menu items.

For the 1.5 ho

The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was wonderful, and they even had live entertainment that night.

As we were leaving, we saw the sign to 'Feed the Fish'

You will love the atmosphere, you will love the food, and you will love the staff.

I had the twin lobster with risotto and fried brussels. It was amazing. My husband had the grouper with the crab meat sauce with the same sides. It too was really good. name: Perdido Key Sports Bar & Restaurant
address: 13583 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Jordan Love
reviews.text:
We were pretty disappointed. It took 20 minutes just to have our order taken, we were never checked on, and we never even received a ticket. My grilled chicken made me sick afterward, and my friend’s chili dog came out cold with unmelted shredded cheese.

The place was extremely dark inside and felt very out of place compared to the beach area. The ranch and Coke were the only positives.

reviews.author: William Wright
reviews.text: Came here for a quick snack and got the Blackened Mahi Salad for only $14! So many other things I wanted to try. Great variety of bar snacks, sandwiches and wings/burgers. Cold beer, always happy daily from 12-6 with awesome bartenders! Also located right near the beach. Great to come and have a casual relaxed dinning experience without breaking the bank! True sports bar lots of tvs!

reviews.author: Monica Stephanie
reviews.text: If you are looking for a "Cheers" episode type of vibe, this is it. Everyone was friendly. The draft beer was cold. I had the mushrooms and they were even good. Their prices are also good. Full bar and menu. A lot of TVs around to watch any sport you can think of. The servers/bartenders are very attentive and have great personalities. You'll really enjoy this place. Can't wait for football season! I will be back

reviews.author: Chris Brooks
reviews.text: Can’t speak on the whole menu as I only had the fried chicken balls (pretty good), but everything here is cheap. I had an appetizer, a draft beer and 2 cocktails for under $25. It’s a fun little dive bar worth stopping at if you’re in the area.

reviews.author: leticia skae
reviews.text:

2) Flavorful food (highly recommend their chicken jalapeño fried balls) 5⭐️
3) Prices and portion sizes 5⭐️ especially since this place is really close to the beach and not as over priced as other spots

address: 50 E Garden St, Pensacola, FL 32502, USA

reviews.author: Rikki Vidak
reviews.text: We held my daughter’s wedding reception in the Garden and Grain Room. It was perfect! Jayden and her staff were so easy to work with, they were with us all the way. It’s easy to decorate. Catering options are convenient. The place is wired for blue tooth which allowed us to play our own music. Just

reviews.author: Morgan Hayes
reviews.text:
Perfect Plain is seriously one of my favorite spots. The bartenders are so nice and genuinely fun to talk to, and they really know what they are doing. If you ask for a recommendation, they actually listen and make something you will love.

The vibe is just as good as the drinks. It is cozy, welcomi

reviews.author: Marlonski Brando
reviews.text: Most breweries in Pensacola close at 10 pm. The fact that they're open until midnight on Thursday and 1 am on Friday and Saturday is 5-stars for me! I only had their lime lager on my quick visit, which tasted good.

reviews.author: Christopher Gugel
reviews.text: Love this brewery! Great beers, friendly staff, and chill vibes. Highly recommend a stop in to see what they’ve got on tap!

reviews.author: Bill Sikora
reviews.text: Such a cool brewery conveniently located right near all of the good stuff in  downtown Pensacola, FL. Our bartender Stephanie was super helpful in helping us choose beers that we would like, and their merch selection was great! Definitely a brewery that I would love to visit again!
