address: 128 E 1st Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Andrea Van Someren
reviews.text: Arrived after a day at the beach and the place was pretty packed. Mostly people playing bingo, others enjoying their food. The girl at the counter was very welcoming and friendly. We ordered waters and when they gave us bottles, she said it was on them. For some reason that blew my mind in a little

reviews.author: Jessi Butler
reviews.text: My family and I came here for the first time for lunch before flying out and we were pleasantly surprised by how great the food was! I myself got The Beach Bowl, which came with a large piece of grilled salmon, jasmine rice, and roasted cauliflower, zucchini, and squash all with an Asian Glaze on to

reviews.author: Balloon Elevations
reviews.text: Love the atmosphere and subdued modern beach aesthetic! You order at the bar and choose your own seat. They have a well rounded menu & excellent flavor. We had the taco sampler and all 3 were delicious! My fav was the Mahi Mahi with shrimp in 2nd and chicken a close 3rd. The chips & salsa were givin

reviews.author: Ashley Morikawa
reviews.text: Super cute, beachy place for some yummy drinks (alcoholic and non). There’s picnic tables on the porch and a couple swings with a kid area, more picnic tables down below the deck covered with umbrellas, and also plenty seating inside. Large variety of drinks, i tried one of the lemonade teas which w

reviews.author: Bryon Harris
reviews.text: We visited this past August. This was our first time in the area and we wanted to try something local with a view.  The food was good.  I had the calamari and a grouper sandwich.  Mom had the fried Gulf shrimp basket.  We thought all three tasted great and were fresh.  I hope you like steps, because

name: Pink Pony Pub
address: 137 E Gulf Pl, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: LandyLane Boutique
reviews.text:
We’re visiting from Kentucky and stopped into Pink Pony Pub tonight on a busy Friday night, and I want to make sure management sees this.

We were told three staff members had called off, and this young lady had already been working since around 10 AM and was still going strong when we were there around 8 PM. She stayed to help so customers wouldn’t suffer.

She definitely went above and beyond. She was incredibly kind, friendly, attentive, and never once let the stress of the night show. Her at

reviews.author: ARTS
reviews.text: I'll start by saying the food and drinks were good. Our server was good, but not friendly. I love crab cakes, so naturally thats what I ordered. $21 on the menu- no problem. Then she says it DOESNT COME WITH A SIDE!!😳 That was an expensive crab!! We chose to eat here because we were staying at the hotel there, but I dont believe we would choose here again if not for that. The red lights on the patio gave off the strangest hue and made all our food look funny.

reviews.author: Kylie Droke
reviews.text: John was our server and was amazing! Not too much, not too little. I had the cheeseburger on sourdough and it was definitely a hit. My sister got the nachos(great shareable plate) and tasted wonderful. A must in Gulf Shores!!!

reviews.author: Rachel Buell
reviews.text: We stopped here while spending time at the Gulf Shores beach. Cute pink building close by to the beach, with a nice view. The staff was friendly and the food came out pretty quickly. My group and I all really liked our food. They got fried gulf shrimp and blackened gulf shrimp. The hush puppies were delicious. The best any of us have had anytime recently. The fries were seasoned and perfectly crispy. I ordered the blackened fish basket and it was as delicious as I could’ve hoped for.

reviews.author: Gary Leemgraven
reviews.text:
Fun Beach Bar, actually on the Beach! Food was delicious. They do have outdoor seating, but it was filled when we went. Parking is Pay in the lots next door. You can park for free across the street. Busy place so you may have a wait.
But worth it

name: Pirates Cove
address: 6664 Co Rd 95, Elberta, AL 36530, USA

reviews.author: Shawn Shepherd
reviews.text:
Cool little local spot to grab food and drinks where you can pull up in your boat (dock or right onto the sand).
There's a small beach and an extra bar area with live music.

I am not a local (yet 😉) and felt a little overdressed arriving with a collared polo, khaki shorts and tennis shoes. So feel free to come as you are with swim trunks and flip flops.

The food was good and the staff were friendly.

They probably need a little more help to keep things cleaned up and don't be surprised to see

reviews.author: Brent Ryals
reviews.text: Great off the beaten path hangout. Mainly a boat up to place, we drove to it. The Bushwackers are great! So are the cheeseburgers. Can be busy at lunch. It's not classy, but a good atmosphere. Small beach for the kids to play on

reviews.author: Phil R
reviews.text:
Second trip to Pirates Cove. Same as the first—still the same old waterfront dive bar that feels like it’s been frozen in time. If you’ve spent any time growing up around water with parents who just kind of let you roam free so they can drink in peace, you know exactly what I mean. Now that I’m an adult, I somehow find myself dragging my own kids to places like this, just so my wife and I can have a drink while the kids do their thing in what we’ll consider a “safe” environment.

The food… it’s

reviews.author: Rick Koller
reviews.text: If you are into Dive bars this place is for you! We loved everything about this little place from the beach bar atmosphere to the open flame grilled burgers. Not to mention the tasty Drinks! We loved it so much we sent a group from our condo about 25-30 people to have a party! I did go there the week before to warn them lol! Thanks from our group to yours for being so gracious and inviting to us!!  Rick

reviews.author: Kerri Monroe-Stevens
reviews.text: Haven’t eaten the food yet. Planning on it in near future, this is my newest treasure!! My pups ABSOLUTELY LOVE coming here, my little chihuahua loves to just roam and greet, while my other sweet blue heeler wants to play fetch! 🐾🥰💙

reviews.text: I want to compliment James on being one of the best managers I have ever been served by. We came in town last week and he was an absolute pleasure to talk to. Being from St. Louis, it's hard to find genuine good customer service from people who care. Thank you for reminding us that good service is still alive in places. We had a great time here! and so will you.

reviews.text: That was a nice cheat day.  I am going to have to run 20 miles to get all this food out of my system.  You can never go wrong with Pizza, specially the Maui Wowi Jumbo Pizza and 16 piece chicken wings.  Nice one!

Espresso machine was down, so no good hot drink with our food. Waitress was inattentive. Overall we were extremely disappointed.

reviews.text:
Exceptional breakfast location right in Gulf Shores, Alabama.
Our server was fast, friendly and cheerful.
The omelette was perfectly prepared and filled, and the cat’s  had biscuit was a perfect addition to the plate. I ate every bit of it!
The atmosphere is loud enough if you bring your children, but not enough if you wanna have a quiet cup of coffee for breakfast
Recommended

Please try the biscuits n gravy if you’re in town. Also, full bar service and a HUGE dinning area. Guess I’ll be back tomorrow😎

reviews.author: Ray Reynolds

It was such a welcoming environment, having your typical dive-bar look, but also super warm and friendly.

The food was so flavorful and original. We had the wings, and they were charred to perfection with the perfect amount of siracha honey sauce.

reviews.author: Ben Nighswonger

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text: Ate here for lunch on a friday. Our waitress was friendly and did a decent job. The food was OK. We loved the French fries. Expensive for what you get imo.

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.text:
Closed at 3:55 pm. Sunny 66 degrees at least 15 people with drinks in the bar area.
Disappointed. Flew down to spend a beautiful week at tylhe Lodge. Their only outside venue closed before 5 o'clock!

reviews.author: Melissa NeSmith
reviews.text: This ocean side bar is everything you want in a coastal hangout—laid-back, welcoming, and absolutely delicious. reviews.author: Kelsey Shures
reviews.text: We loved our visit to the dragonfly, the mocktail flavors watermelon and Pina colada were SO good! As well as the wings, cheese curds, and crab ragoon! The kids loved the pool and fire to warm up by after.  We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Lee Roberts
reviews.text: Visited the pool as a guest of Gulf State Park cabins. Very nice atmosphere here by the Dragonfly. Great views! Food was good, but pricey - to be expected at beach venues.

reviews.author: Deep South
reviews.text: Google shows temporarily closed, but I was here on Jan. 2nd, 2026 and they were certainly open. Busy bar, they could use another bartender even in the not so off season. I was surprised by how good the food was! Got the oyster sampler, which wasn't listed on the main menu??? My wife had the flatbread and it was good too. Ice cold beer and well prepared food. What more could you ask for?

reviews.author: AB R
reviews.text: Stopped in for lunch, shout out to the best & our favorite server there, HANNAH Mc. Fried crab claws still delicious and nutritious and the tuna dip was fantastic with the new chips. C power forever. #Cpowa #IYKYK

reviews.author: Kellis Williams
reviews.text:
Easy 20/5 stars. This place is the real deal!
We heard nothing but rave reviews all the way from Southern Illinois — and now we know why. Flora-Bama Yacht Club absolutely crushed it. Killer food, lightning-fast service, and one of the most laid-back, family-friendly vibes on the coast. Kids comfortable. Adults relaxed. Zero stress.

reviews.author: Jennifer Olson
reviews.text: The food was excellent, everything we ate was so good. Bradley and Patrise gave excellent service with a wonderful personality. We will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Randi Kittrell

Genuine Irish pub atmosphere.
Great selection of beers and spirits with terrific service. The Reuben is decent; the home fries are PERFECT! Don't sleep on those fries🤤

reviews.author: Aulman Watford
reviews.text:
Fantastic spot. Great games, good vibe, exceptional karaoke, and food trucks. Excellent way to spend an evening.

The people are nice, with a good mix of people on the west side (the best side) and a really fun and inclusive atmosphere.

Bring your kids before 8 or 9?  You will all have a ball.

name: The Gulf
address: 27500 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Shane
reviews.text: This place is my jam. On the water, great cocktails, great seafood. If we go to a place two nights in a row, you know we like it. Service was excellent both nights. Bobbie Jean and Yil took great care of us tonight and Panda the night before. If you're really hungry get something that comes with fries. We had the snapper BLT and the lobster and shrimp roll and that's a lot of food. The prior night was the poke bowl and mahi -mahi tacos...a little lighter.

reviews.author: Ellie Gunn
reviews.text: Really great lobster and shrimp roll. Even the fries are actually good - sometimes places skimp on the quality of their fries. Even on a chilly day having lunch by myself, I grabbed a hot toddy and enjoyed this view and had a great time. Tammy was really awesome. She always showed up at just the right time and was super kind. The folks behind the register and the bar were also incredibly kind and professional. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Shari Kaauwai
reviews.text: I was curious about this place solely based on the reviews & photos describing The Gulf’s construction was made up of former shipping containers!! Coming from Hawaii 🌺, we receive our goods in shipping containers so of course, I was curious and had to visit. reviews.author: Joseph Raczynski
reviews.text: Clean, excellent service, and very good food. You order from a bar or walk up, and they deliver. The views of the channel and waterway is clear. It's informal but has a good vibe.

reviews.author: Chris Wilkinson
reviews.text: We had shrimp tacos and a shrimp bowl. Both were excellent.  Our food runner, Colin, was great. He checked on us several times, made sure we had what we needed and even took pictures for us.

name: The Hangout
address: 101 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Deidre Knapp
reviews.text: What a cool place!  It uses unique items as part of their decor!  The way burger, fries & Gouda grits & sweet tea  were excellent.  My server, Shay was friendly, professional and attentive.  She recommended a signature sauce to use for my fries.  Delish!  I sat on their deck and was able to enjoy a little more of the beach from a different perspective!

reviews.author: R A
reviews.text: My family and I ate here on a Friday evening, around 7 PM, November 28, 2025. They were not very busy. We were seated pretty quickly. reviews.author: Madison Neal
reviews.text: Visited Hangout in the “off season” and had a great experience. Food came out quickly and was fabulous. I recommend the redfish and shrimp and grits. Our waitress Mauve was excellent. Restaurant was clean with a good atmosphere on the front patio.

reviews.author: Kimeisha C.
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at The Hangout on the Beach in Gulf Shores! Our waiter, TJ, was absolutely amazing—friendly, kind, funny, and very informative. His menu suggestions were spot on, and he made the whole experience even better. I truly wish him and his fiancée nothing but the best in their future endeavors.

The overall vibe of the restaurant was awesome—fun, energetic, and welcoming. I loved seeing the staff and birthday guests dancing on the tables, which made the atmosphere feel li

reviews.author: Ashley Lawson
reviews.text: First time going to the Hangout to have dinner yesterday evening and it was phenomenal! Ricky made our experience absolutely fantastic! Extremely tentative and kept us laughing the whole time just making sure we had everything we needed as well a great time! 100/10 rating! Will certainly go back every year we come to Orange Beach. Our kids loved being here and it was such a great experience.

I ordered an appetizer, Crab wonton and a couple of sushi rolls, the Man of War and Alaskan. Tasty but a little on the smaller side compared to other sushi places I've eaten. The rest of the menu looks great, you won't be disappointed bringing your friends here! 🪼

reviews.author: Tommy LaConte

reviews.author: Lori Hootman

You will have a great experience, guaranteed!

reviews.author: Stephanie Thompson
reviews.text: Had dinner on a Thursday evening when they a had a band playing wonderful music! Enjoyed the combination appetizer platter- fried green tomatoes, alligator bites and fried crab claws. Great food and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Christine Lipscomb

We got started with bar drinks and 2 appetizers. My entree was a platter featuring fried oysters, grilled grouper, scallops, hush puppies, baked potato and vegetable of the day (green beans). The homemade tartar sauce is very good. My husband had the fresh fish and 2 sides.

reviews.author: Cassandra Evans
reviews.text: We had the gumbo, coconut, shrimp, and the red fish special with grilled shrimp and mushroom gravy on top. The onion rings were good. Everything we had was delicious . We had excellent service from our server Ryan.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: We tried this place recently for lunch and it was good. There was a lot of seating on the outdoor patio and several tables inside. They have a wide variety of options. The smoked tuna dip was a great starter. The red fish and grilled shrimp po boy were excellent. There was so much shrimp on the po boy I couldn't eat it as a sandwich, which I thought was great. Service was excellent. The new location is awesome right on the water.

name: Shell Beach Orange Beach Public Parking
address: 28273 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Hannah Huguenin
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent the afternoon here!  Although they call it shell beach I think it should be called butterfly beach.  The butterflies were everywhere!  As you can see I made friends with one.

A local fisherman we chatted with said you can catch grouper, shark, flounder, pompano, and whiting.

reviews.author: Amber Dutton
reviews.text: Beautiful spot to watch the sunset. Lots of pretty shells along the shore and white sandy beaches. Parking is limited and you have to pay to park but overall worth it. Not a lot of people during a weeknight.

reviews.author: Rachael Hill
reviews.text: Loved the beach. Would have enjoyed an outdoor shower to rinse the sand off after our stay. $45 for a chair & umbrella for the day. Limited parking spots to keep beach from being crowded. Adorable $10 parking for all day! Lots of pretty shells and the perfect laid back day!

reviews.author: Jeremiah DuPree
reviews.text:
Great beach, parking is usually full and costs around $10

The beach had some great shells that wash up also, usually a tad bit bigger than some other beaches in the area.

They do have portable bathrooms, I may have some hand sanitizer and some tissues on hand, though.

reviews.author: Bridget grace
reviews.text: Was there on a windy day so had the beach all to myself.   Early March is a good time to go to avoid the crowd and sandfleas..

name: Shipp’s Dockside Grill
address: 27075 Marina Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marlo Schofield
reviews.text: Our waiter was so fantastic! His service was amazing! So friendly and attentive. He said he was 22 but it seemed more like lucky 777’s 🍀! Five stars ! Thank you for a wonderful evening! Food was also delicious!

reviews.author: Pamela Pruett
reviews.text: Tajhe is an exceptional worker. I was impressed. Crab bisque was yummy. My filet mignon was butter melting in my mouth. Gravy was too salty and the French fried onion rings were not edible. Mashed potatoes we're good and didn't touch the green beans. The southern rum bread pudding was 1/2 a pan!!! Yum!!!!!

reviews.author: Eric Mealus
reviews.text: Wow, if the food taste matched the food looks this place would be fantastic.  Instead, we left a bit disappointed.  Of the three dishes we had at our table, the Grouper was the best of the three; both sides though were cold and the greens were on the sweet side.  The eggplant dish and the crab quesadilla dish were not worth every ordering again.  The eggplant was undercooked.  There was plenty of crab in the quesadilla and it was oddly tasteless.

reviews.author: jettt111
reviews.text: My gosh. We just ate here and got the Thursday filet mignon for old times sake. It was melt in your mouth tender , I got the tomato vinegarette dressing and it was the best ever. I added a lobster tail with melted butter and it was cooked perfectly. Our waitress was named “special “.  She was perfect with everything. It was a meal to remember.

reviews.author: Stephanie Thompson
reviews.text: This is our third year coming to the area and this was hands down the best meal we’ve had yet. The Creole and Rockefeller oysters were fantastic but the star of the show was the grouper pontchartrain. Best grouper we’ve ever had. The fried oyster salad was delicious as well. Our server Jocelyn was friendly and attentive. Wish we would have come here at the beginning of our vacation vs the end because we would definitely go back!

Wasn’t even cold just seemed like they threw ice on top with no shaking and it didn’t even seem like the coffee was mixed together to be evenly distributed. As well the coffee cup broke while driving leaving a big mess in my car. 6$+ for a bad medium sized coffee then gonna ask if I wanna tip? Please go to local coffee shops not this flavorless overpriced company.

reviews.author: Crystal Harris
reviews.text: I stopped here while on a short trip in the area. I am not a Starbucks regular, but I needed to work on a laptop for a couple of hours and this was the perfect place for that! I ordered lunch and couple drinks that I thought sounded tasty. The staff were all great! The food was fresh and delicious, as were the drinks. Everyone's orders seemed to be completed impressively quick! While I was there, I heard them greet every customer with a warm welcome and even addressed several customers by name.

Whenever you visit Target and there’s a Starbucks inside you have to visit right?

We will definitely return here

Oh, I was wearing my green Elf shirt and a Target employee mistaken me for a Shipt employee, lol

The owners are completely knowledgeable, helpful, and supportive of everyone that walks in their venue. Whether it's skating, surfing, or just advice on moving to the area. You'll feel like you're at home every time you walk through the door.

reviews.text: Tambo’s is the place to go around here! was on vacation and stop in! sick shop 10/10 would recommend!!

reviews.author: Jc Caamano

We are definitely going back when we are back in Orange Beach.

I dont recommend this location to anyone. If good service is something you appreciate, I recommend you steer clear of Foley honeybaked ham and drive elsewhere!!!

The cake was amazing and everyone was very happy with cake, but I was more amazed by their customer service

reviews.text: incredibly delicious ham and sandwiches. they are running a weekly special deal for $9.99 with a sandwich, drink, and cookie right now. my favorite sandwich is “the honeybaked”. if you’re looking for a lowkey lunch spot, ham for a special occasion, or frozen dinner/sides, this is the place!

reviews.author: C Gehringer
reviews.text: Bought small ham for four people and roasted turkey. Spent $107. Ham was mostly FAT! Was embarrassed to serve  it for our company New Year's Year. Spent half hour cutting off FAT as we needed food for our company. Never have We had such a bad cut of Honey Baked Ham! Turkey was good! The lady never showed me the ham prior to wrapping it up which I thought was odd ( cameras should prove this). Can't recommend this place.

name: The Southern Grind Coffee House at the WHARF
address: 4751 Main St #116, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Autumn Bough (7autumn5)
reviews.text: We had breakfast and coffee. Surprisingly Southern Grind has the best bacon I’ve ever had in my life. We also had lovely outdoor seating which accommodated us with our little dog. While we were there the police chief came by to say hello and pet our dog! The coffee was amazing and we bought some whole bean coffee to take home. It was an excellent experience. You can’t get more southern hospitality than this place.

reviews.author: Alyssa Campbell
reviews.text: This is a cute little coffee shop located within The Wharf. It was one of the only shops open on Saturday morning. They have a nice selection of coffee beverages and breakfast/dessert items.

reviews.author: Reni
reviews.text: Went to this coffee shop awhile back on a girls trip in Orange Beach. The restaurant is connected to Hotel Indigo, but there is parking right outside of the coffee shop as well. If you are in the area and in search of a good breakfast/brunch spot…look no further.  Breakfast menu has a wide selection and there’s enough there to choose from to satisfy the pickiest of eaters. We ate here almost every day for breakfast and each time, we were highly satisfied with the service and quality of food. The

reviews.author: Brady Middleton
reviews.text: We had breakfast here multiple times on a recent trip to OB.  The biscuits and gravy are a hit as well as the french toast!  The coffee is phenomenal and the atmosphere is the ultimate beach theme.  We didn't purchase any gifts or items in the store, but they offer a wide range of unique, beach themed items to choose from.  100% will be back.

reviews.author: Justin Barnes
reviews.text: This is our first time checking out this place and what they were about. The staff was incredibly friendly and super helpful. I had the avocado toast with bacon and hot honey, it was delicious!!! My wife had the omelette with spinach and mushrooms. Incredibly good. The ambiance and environment Beverly chill and five with great outdoor seating. The coffee was stout and tasty. I'm a big fan and will be coming back for sure

reviews.text: Southern Grind is such a gem in Gulf Shores! The shop itself is super cute with a warm and welcoming vibe. The staff were incredibly friendly and personable, which made the experience even better. I ordered a latte and it was a 10/10—so good that I finished it before I even made it home! This place definitely deserves a spot on your coffee stop list if you’re in the area. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Katrina Ricker
reviews.text: Avocado toasts were really good with crispy thick pieces of bacon! The two coffees we got were also super good. Both were sweet coffees and a little strong on the syrup, but you were still able to taste the coffee. So good!
